description: Implementation of the WindowUpdatePayloadDecoder class for decoding HTTP/2 WINDOW_UPDATE frames in the quiche HTTP/2 library.

classes.name: WindowUpdatePayloadDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for processing HTTP/2 WINDOW_UPDATE frame payloads.

methods.name: StartDecodingPayload
methods.description: Begins decoding the payload of a WINDOW_UPDATE frame, handling the case where the payload is fully in the buffer.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingPayload
methods.description: Resumes decoding of the payload when it is not fully available at once.

methods.name: HandleStatus
methods.description: Handles the decoding status, finalizing the process or reporting errors.
